tonight.headline: The Pickens claim closes at 01:00 tonight; the tight end and defence are done, Tuten is not
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4, Barkley did not practise and is unlikely for London, and Tuten, 3.1 above Gordon, is still on your bench for the third brief running. The tight-end seat changed hands twice today, Waller to Strange to Loveland, which is the churn this system keeps warning about.

The rest is better. The slot that projected zero now holds Loveland at 9.7 and the Jaguars replaced the Ravens, so you project 114.6 as set against 123.3 and ESPN gives you 46%, up from 39% this morning. One deadline is left today: George Pickens is still on waivers until 01:00 on Thursday, he is not on Dallas's final injury report, and the claim window closes overnight. Put it in with Downs as the drop.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 15.1 with an ankle his coach calls 'just maintenance', Tee Higgins 14.3 after missing Wednesday's practice (groin/neck), Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7. Their defence is still Kansas City's, on bye at 0.0, so their number rises when they fix it.

case.label: Your side once it is set
case.body: Taylor 19.0, Lawrence 18.1, Wilson 14.8, Tuten 14.0, Tate 13.6, Golden 12.7, Loveland 9.7, Myers 8.7 and the Jaguars 7.7: 118.3. Pickens, if the claim lands, is 13.3 and a coin flip with Golden for the flex.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Higgins or Love sitting, on their side. On yours, nothing on Wednesday's reports touches a projected starter.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Waivers clear Thu 01:00 Mexico City · the window closes overnight · he plays Thu 18:15
doFirst.title: Put in the claim for George Pickens tonight
doFirst.subtitle: Drop Josh Downs. He is still on waivers this afternoon, he is not on Dallas's final injury report, and this is the last brief before the claim processes. You are 7th of ten; a claim that fails costs nothing.

case.label: The player
case.body: Healthy: Dallas's final report for Thursday carries no designation for him or for Dak Prescott (dallascowboys.com; Cowboys On SI, 7 Oct). Second receiver behind CeeDee Lamb; targets 6, 8, 11, 3 (archive), the 3 for 75 yards. I found no injury, discipline or trade story that explains the drop; the only knock is production: no touchdown yet, and RotoWire has him 51st among receivers in yards per route while ranking him WR14 for this week. Tampa Bay start an undrafted rookie quarterback and are without Antoine Winfield Jr.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Josh Downs: 12.1 this week and 134.6 for the season, the lowest receiver number on your roster, against Pickens's 13.3 and 176.6. Keenan Allen returned to practice on Wednesday, which takes targets from Downs and is not in his number yet. He is 82% owned, so this disagrees with the market on the record. Downs is not on the screen's exposure list.

case.label: Why this is the one to spend priority on
case.body: The strategy allows a claim only for a player who would start at once. Pickens would: 13.3 is above Golden's 12.7 for the flex. That is a coin flip and gets no lineup thesis; the case is the season number and the role. The price is three places, 7th to 10th, in an order that never resets, and only if the claim wins. Six managers are ahead of you.

case.label: If it lands
case.body: He plays on Thursday at 18:15 Mexico City, seventeen hours after waivers clear. Put him in the flex before then: 13.3 against Golden's 12.7, the projection's call. If you do not look on Thursday, he locks on your bench.

case.label: The honest risk
case.body: He is the second option behind a receiver who drew 21 targets last week, and your record on adds is poor. Neither the waiver tool nor the wire screen surfaced him: both measure rising usage, and a just-dropped starter does not rise. This card is my judgement, not the tool's. I also cannot see whether you have already entered the claim.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Downs outscores Pickens in two of Weeks 5 to 7 (archive), or Pickens draws fewer than six targets in two of those three games.

doFirst.title: Start Tuten in the RB slot, not Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: Still not done, for the third brief running. The projection has Tuten 3.1 higher, 14.0 to 10.9, and he kicks off first.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: lineup_check.py: start Tuten over Gordon, PROJECTION, 3.1 points. It is the only change outside the coin-flip line. As set you project 114.6; the projection lineup is 118.3.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: 17 of Jacksonville's 23 backfield carries in Week 4 (archive). Jacksonville are 7-point favourites in London against an Eagles team that traded its centre on Wednesday and starts a rookie at right tackle. No Jaguars injury report is out, and nothing on him is newer than Sunday.

case.label: Why not Gordon
case.body: Jeff Hafley praised him on Wednesday, 'He's going full speed and not stopping', and still named no starter. 9 carries for 100 last week, more than half on one run. Miami are 6.5-point underdogs. You spent a claim on him and a start would count toward that thesis; that is not a reason to give up three points.

case.label: The flex is a coin flip
case.body: Downs is in the flex at 12.1 and the projection prefers Golden at 12.7. That is 0.6, so take Golden and write nothing down. If the Pickens claim lands, Downs is gone and Pickens takes the flex on Thursday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gordon outscores Tuten on Sunday (archive).

whatWentWrong.lead: You added Strange for Waller at 09:52, as the brief said, and swapped Strange for Loveland at 13:06. The slot is filled; the churn rule now closes it.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Activity log: Waller dropped for Strange at 15:52 UTC, Strange dropped for Loveland at 19:06 UTC. Both project 9.7. This morning's brief ranked Strange first on a role nobody's injury explained and Loveland second on one game from a backup quarterback.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing to do. Loveland starts and the seat is closed until 14 Oct unless he is ruled out. It is the third change at that position in five days, and the open thesis is now graded on Loveland against Strange.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A ruling-out. Not a projection, and not Hockenson's 10.4.

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: You held him for three hours today. Free again, level with Loveland, and not a move.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95 on 87% of the snaps in Week 4, with every Jacksonville pass-catcher healthy (archive; PlayerProfiler). Targets 3, 2, 5, 8.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9.7, the same as Loveland, and the seat changed twice today. Philadelphia allow the fifth-fewest points to tight ends and Jacksonville are off in Week 7; Loveland has no bye until Week 10. FantasyPros advises against chasing him this week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out. Nothing else reopens the seat before 14 Oct.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · PlayerProfiler · FantasyPros · activity log

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson
worthALook.lead: The highest-projected free tight end, and Wednesday helped him: Addison sat and Jefferson was only limited.

case.label: The role
case.body: 13 catches on 13 targets for 119 with Jefferson out (archive). On Wednesday Jefferson was limited and Jordan Addison did not practise with a hamstring (vikings.com, 7 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.4 against Loveland's 9.7 is a coin flip, the seat is closed, and Minnesota are off in Week 6, which would empty the slot again in five days.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out and Jefferson ruled out with him.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · vikings.com · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Will Shipley
worthALook.lead: The handcuff to your Barkley. Philadelphia signed a second back on Wednesday.

case.label: The role
case.body: Barkley did not practise and is 'unlikely to play' in London; Bigsby is on injured reserve. ESPN projects Shipley 10.2.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Dameon Pierce was signed to the 53 on Wednesday, so the work is shared. 15 carries all season. 10.2 is below Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, and no seat is open that is not a starter or protected.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley going on injured reserve. Then the seat question is asked again, and Downs's seat is the candidate if the Pickens claim has not used it.

worthALook.sources: Philadelphia Inquirer · PFT · RotoWire · Week 4 archive

worthALook.name: Cowboys D/ST
worthALook.lead: The highest-projected free defence, 0.7 above the Jaguars you added today.

case.label: The role
case.body: Dallas host Tampa Bay on Thursday. Baker Mayfield is out and an undrafted rookie starts; FantasyPros ranks Dallas 1st, BetMGM 3rd, NBC 9th. The spread has come in from −10 to −7.5 across books.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 0.7 is a coin flip and the defence seat changed at 12:40 today. Dallas ruled out cornerback Cobie Durant and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. The seat is closed.

worthALook.sources: ESPN league file · FantasyPros · BetMGM · dallascowboys.com · Covers

doNotChase.name: Mark Andrews
doNotChase.lead: Carried: his quarterback did not practise on Wednesday.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The steadiest targets of the free tight ends, 6, 7, 5, 6, and a full practice on Wednesday with a hand listing.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Lamar Jackson (ankle) did not practise and Tyler Huntley took the first-team work; RotoWire thinks Jackson more likely than not to sit. Baltimore did not score in the half Huntley played. 9.6, level with Loveland, for a closed seat.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jackson practising on Thursday, and Loveland ruled out.

doNotChase.sources: Russell Street Report · baltimoreravens.com · RotoWire · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.lead: Still rising on the wire with no team.

case.label: The number that kills it

case.label: What would change it

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Carried, nothing new: target share in an offence that threw for 85 yards.

case.label: The number that kills it

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Carried: six targets with Smith out, in an offence that threw for 93 yards.

case.label: The rise

case.label: The number that kills it

case.label: What would change it

doNotChase.name: Dontayvion Wicks
doNotChase.lead: Carried: Philadelphia's most-used receiver by snaps, and quiet three weeks running.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 56 of 61 snaps with Smith out (NBC Sports Philadelphia).

case.label: The number that kills it

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight names clear the tool's bar, all of them on this morning's list, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. The tight ends have dropped off the list because Loveland, added today, is inside the expert top 24. None of the eight is a move. The tool still does not print George Pickens, who is the first card: it looks for rising usage, and he was dropped, not rising.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation by design: he led the Chargers' backs with 26 snaps in Week 4, and Omarion Hampton has been under half the snaps since Week 2 (FantasyPros; Fantasy Life, 7 Oct). The depth chart still lists Hampton first. The Chargers are off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third; the trigger is Hampton missing a game

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is healthy; neither is on Atlanta's Wednesday report. The pair combined for 33 carries and five touchdowns against New Orleans, three of them Brian's (atlantafalcons.com, 7 Oct). No coach has described a split. Nicky Jam added him in your other league today.
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns and game script behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: He and Kaleb Johnson both fumbled in Week 4 and Matt LaFleur says fumblers sit. Chris Brooks (ankle) did not practise on Wednesday. Green Bay are last in rushing at 58 yards a game and Josh Jacobs is still on the exempt list with no ruling. You dropped him for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — volume at 1.9 yards a carry in a backfield nobody has won

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty's handcuff: 9 carries for 18 on a season-high 18 snaps while Jeanty 'subbed himself out' with an ankle (Athlon, 5 Oct). Jeanty practised in full on Wednesday (raiders.com). Yahoo ranks him a top-five stash.
rising.action: WATCH — nothing unless Jeanty's ankle costs him a practice

rising.name: Devaughn Vele
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 9 targets while Shough threw 48 times from behind. Jordyn Tyson is unlikely before Week 7. On Wednesday Shough was limited with a wrapped left hand and Chris Olave rested. The steadiest role on this list, against Minnesota's defence.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role, as a sixth receiver; there is no seat

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint. Buffalo play on Monday and have published no report, so Moore's status is unknown; Keon Coleman is the Bill the columns prefer.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting, unknown until Thursday

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Dislocated his left ankle in Week 4; surgery this week, out 12 to 16 weeks (Rapoport via NBC Sports, 5 Oct), confirmed again today.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: 6 catches for 116 and a touchdown after DJ Moore left. The role is exactly as long as Moore's absence, and Buffalo's first report is Thursday.
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out

cannotSee.label: Whether the Pickens claim is in
cannotSee.body: ESPN shows only your own claims and the published file carries none of them. Six managers are ahead of you in the order. If any of them claims him, yours fails and costs nothing.

cannotSee.label: Why he was dropped
cannotSee.body: No injury, discipline or trade story was found, and Dallas's final report does not list him. The manager who dropped him also has no quarterback projected above zero. I read it as a mistake; I cannot rule out something unreported.

cannotSee.label: Barkley
cannotSee.body: No Wednesday quote from Nick Sirianni about him was found and the official Eagles report was not out. 'Did not practise' is three reporters' observation. Nobody has reported whether he travels on Friday.

cannotSee.label: Jacksonville and Seattle
cannotSee.body: Neither team had published a Wednesday report when this was written. Lawrence's, Tuten's, the defence's and Myers's rows rest on the absence of news. Caleb Ransaw's reported move to injured reserve is a headline I could not open.

cannotSee.label: Thursday's and Friday's reports
cannotSee.body: Kamara's back listing is an estimate from a walkthrough. Keenan Allen was limited in his first practice back; whether he plays decides how many targets Downs sees.

cannotSee.label: The tight-end order
cannotSee.body: This morning's brief put Strange ahead of Loveland on a tie at 9.7. You chose the other way. Neither choice has evidence the other lacks, and the seat is closed now.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades and lines
cannotSee.body: Tiles are carried from Tuesday's FootballDB full-PPR table; this run could only open the standard-scoring version. Chicago–Green Bay and Seattle–San Francisco lines are Tuesday's or come from pages that disagree by half a point.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Kendre Miller, Jaylen Wright, Isaiah Williams and Oronde Gadsden are not on the published wire, so their availability here is the screen's inference. Dohnte Meyers was new to this league's screen today; the other verdicts were re-read against Wednesday's reports.

cannotSee.body: The official Eagles, Jaguars, Seahawks, Chargers and Cardinals Wednesday reports; ESPN's injury and odds pages; Bleeding Green Nation, Blogging the Boys and Big Cat Country. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Barkley and Rice have no scan grades; nothing can be priced.

cannotSee.body: Still on the commissioner's exempt list with no ruling (Heavy, 6 Oct). He projects 0.0.
